name: Kaiser Permanente Panorama City
campus_description: Multi-building campus with 6 medical office buildings (Buildings 2-6), a hospital, and a 3A annex. Two main parking areas: Cantara Street structures serve Buildings 2, 3, 4. Ventura Canyon / Willard structure serves Buildings 5, 6, Hospital, and Emergency. A bridge connects Building 5 to the hospital. Building 5 is a newer 3-story specialty building with a glass atrium (opened 2014). A tram shuttle runs between parking and buildings during varying hours.

parking.name: Cantara Street Parking Structures
parking.entrance_note: Exit toward campus. Buildings 2, 3, and 4 are straight ahead. Patient drop-off/pickup at Building 3A. You can also park on the roof of the member parking structure.

parking.name: Ventura Canyon / Willard Parking Structure
parking.entrance_note: Exit toward Roscoe Blvd. Building 6 and Urgent Care are ahead. Building 5 and Hospital are to your left. Emergency Department has a separate entrance with red signage.

departments.name: Lab / Blood Draw (Building 3)
departments.check_in: Check in at the lab window
departments.directions_from_cantara: Exit Cantara St parking toward campus. Building 3 is straight ahead — look for the covered walkway with glass doors. Enter through automatic doors. Take elevator to basement level. Lab window is straight ahead when you exit the elevator.

departments.name: Lab / Blood Draw (Building 5)
departments.check_in: Check in at the lab reception desk
departments.directions_from_ventura: Exit Ventura Canyon parking. Building 5 is to your left — the newer 3-story building with the glass atrium. Enter through the ground floor entrance (automatic doors). Lab reception is on Level 1.

departments.name: X-ray / Bone Density (DEXA)
departments.check_in: Check in at the radiology window
departments.directions_from_cantara: Exit Cantara St parking toward campus. Building 3 is straight ahead. Enter through automatic glass doors. Take elevator to basement. Radiology is past the lab on your right.

departments.name: MRI / CT Scan / Ultrasound
departments.check_in: Check in at the imaging reception desk
departments.directions_from_ventura: Exit Ventura Canyon parking. Building 5 is the newer 3-story building with the glass atrium, to your left. Enter through the ground floor entrance (automatic doors). Imaging reception is straight ahead.

departments.name: Mammography / Breast Imaging
departments.check_in: Check in at the breast imaging desk
departments.directions_from_ventura: Exit Ventura Canyon parking. Building 5 is the newer building with the glass atrium, to your left. Enter through the ground floor entrance (automatic doors). Breast imaging is to the right past imaging reception.

departments.name: Radiology / Diagnostic Imaging
departments.check_in: Check in at hospital radiology reception
departments.directions_from_ventura: Exit Ventura Canyon parking. The hospital is to your left past Building 5 — look for the large Kaiser sign and the emergency entrance nearby. Enter through the main hospital entrance (automatic doors). Follow signs to Radiology.

departments.name: Pediatrics
departments.check_in: Check in at the pediatrics front desk
departments.directions_from_cantara: Exit Cantara St parking toward campus. Building 2 is on your left — the first building you see. Enter through main doors (automatic, accessible). Take elevator to 2nd floor. Pediatrics is to your right.

departments.name: Pharmacy (Cantara / Building 3)
departments.check_in: Take a number at the pharmacy counter
departments.directions_from_cantara: Exit Cantara St parking toward campus. Building 3 is straight ahead. Enter through automatic glass doors. Pharmacy is on the ground floor to your right.

departments.name: Pharmacy (Ventura Canyon / Building 6)
departments.check_in: Take a number at the pharmacy counter
departments.directions_from_ventura: Exit Ventura Canyon parking toward Roscoe Blvd. Building 6 is directly ahead — look for the pharmacy sign. Enter through ground floor doors (automatic, accessible). Pharmacy counter is straight ahead.

departments.name: Internal Medicine / Adult Care
departments.check_in: Check in at the front desk on 3rd floor
departments.directions_from_cantara: Exit Cantara St parking toward campus. Building 4 is past Building 3 on your right. Enter through main doors (automatic, accessible). Take elevator to 3rd floor. Check in at the front desk.

departments.name: OB/GYN
departments.check_in: Check in at the OB/GYN front desk
departments.directions_from_cantara: Exit Cantara St parking toward campus. Building 3 is straight ahead. Enter through automatic glass doors. OB/GYN is on the 1st floor — follow signs from the lobby.

departments.name: Ophthalmology / Eye Care
departments.check_in: Check in at the ophthalmology desk
departments.directions_from_cantara: Exit Cantara St parking toward campus. Building 4 is past Building 3 on your right. Enter through main doors (automatic, accessible). Take elevator to 3rd floor. Ophthalmology is straight ahead.

departments.name: Cardiology
departments.check_in: Check in at the cardiology front desk
departments.directions_from_cantara: Exit Cantara St parking toward campus. Building 4 is past Building 3 on your right. Enter through main doors (automatic, accessible). Take elevator to 3rd floor. Cardiology is in Area 308.

departments.name: Dermatology
departments.check_in: Check in at the dermatology front desk
departments.directions_from_ventura: Exit Ventura Canyon parking toward Roscoe Blvd. Building 6 is directly ahead. Enter through ground floor doors (automatic, accessible). Dermatology is on the 1st and 2nd floors — check in at the front desk.

departments.name: Allergy
departments.check_in: Check in at the allergy department desk
departments.directions_from_ventura: Exit Ventura Canyon parking toward Roscoe Blvd. Building 6 is directly ahead. Enter through ground floor doors (automatic, accessible). Take elevator to 2nd floor. Allergy is in Area 290.

departments.name: Audiology / Hearing
departments.check_in: Check in at the audiology desk
departments.directions_from_ventura: Exit Ventura Canyon parking. Building 5 is the newer 3-story building with the glass atrium, to your left. Enter through the ground floor entrance (automatic doors). Take elevator to Level 2. Audiology is on your right.

departments.name: Urgent Care
departments.check_in: Check in at the urgent care front desk
departments.directions_from_ventura: Exit Ventura Canyon parking toward Roscoe Blvd. Building 6 is directly ahead — look for the Urgent Care sign. Enter through the ground floor entrance (automatic doors). Urgent care check-in is straight ahead.

departments.name: Emergency Department
departments.check_in: Go directly to the emergency entrance — do not go to the main hospital entrance
departments.directions_from_ventura: Exit Ventura Canyon parking and look for the red EMERGENCY sign on the hospital building. Follow the signs to the emergency entrance — it's separate from the main hospital doors. Automatic doors, fully accessible.
